card.name: Warning phrases near keep-out-of-reach text
card.fires_on: Short linking words or punctuation inside over-the-counter warning blocks, especially 'not' after Do, 'of' after In case, and bullet marks, usually right after 'Keep out of reach of children'.

modes.label: The phrase "Do not"
modes.description: The word 'not' after 'Do' in a warning instruction.
modes.example: Warning: Keep out of reach of children. Do<< not>> swallow.

modes.label: The phrase "In case of"
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'In case' leading into an overdose instruction.
modes.example: WARNINGS: If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use. Keep out of reach of children. In case<< of>> overdose, get medical help or contact a

modes.label: Separators in warning lists
modes.description: A bullet or colon or space that opens the next warning item.
modes.example: consult a healthcare professional before use.<< •>> Keep out of reach of children. •
